high_level_description: This image is a stylized, artistic depiction featuring two characters in an urban setting. The background prominently displays a large mural of Venom, the iconic Marvel Comics antihero, painted on a wall. The mural is highly detailed, with Venom's menacing face and open mouth showing sharp teeth, creating a dramatic and intense atmosphere. In front of the mural stands a person wearing a Spider-Man hoodie and dark pants. The Spider-Man hoodie has a white spider emblem on the chest, and the individual is also wearing white sneakers.
